get.summary: Get played movies with watch dates of user
get.description: Get all played movies with watch dates set. Sorted by most recently watch dates on default.

post.summary: Add movie play with watch date set to user
post.description: Create or update the provided watch dates for the specified movies. A date for plays is required.

put.summary: Replace movie play with watch date set for user
put.description: Create or replace the provided watch dates for the specified movies. A date for plays is required.

delete.summary: Delete movie watch dates from user history
delete.description: Delete the specified movie watch dates. A watch date is required for every movie.

get.summary: Get movies in watchlist of user
get.description: Get all movies on the user watchlist. Sorted by most recently added on default.

post.summary: Add movie to watchlist of user

delete.summary: Delete movie from watchlist of user

get.description: Get all played movies and their watch dates.

post.description: Create or update the provided watch dates for the specified movies.

put.description: Create or replace the provided watch dates for the specified movies.

delete.description: Delete all watch dates of specified movies if no specific watch dates are provided.

get.summary: Get available posters for a movie
get.description: Gets the English-language TMDB posters available for a movie. Requires an administrator's personal API token.

hasOverride.description: True when an administrator selected a poster instead of using TMDB's default.

put.summary: Select a poster for a movie
put.description: Selects one of the movie's available TMDB posters as its global poster. Requires an administrator's personal API token.

delete.summary: Restore the default poster for a movie
delete.description: Removes the global poster selection so the movie uses TMDB's current default poster. Requires an administrator's personal API token.

get.summary: Get the user's review of a movie
get.description: Get the authenticated user's private review for the specified movie.

put.summary: Create or update the user's review of a movie
put.description: Create or replace the authenticated user's review for the specified movie.

delete.summary: Delete the user's review of a movie
delete.description: Delete the authenticated user's review for the specified movie. The operation succeeds when the movie exists but has no review.

post.summary: Add movie via external provider id
post.description: Adds a new movie via external data provider

get.description: Search remotely on tmdb for the movie with the specified search filters. Movies already existing locally will have a Movary id set.

isWatched.description: True if user has watched the movie, false if not.

isOnWatchlist.description: True if user has the movie on the watchlist, false if not.

post.description: Endpoint to scrobble your Plex watches to Movary.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: An UUID that is generated by the user in the Plex settings.

post.description: Endpoint to scrobble your Jellyfin watches to Movary.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: An UUID that is generated by the user in the Jellyfin settings.

post.description: Endpoint to scrobble your Emby watches to Movary.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: An UUID that is generated by the user in the Emby settings.

post.description: Endpoint to scrobble your Kodi watches to Movary.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: An UUID that is generated by the user in the Kodi settings.

get.summary: Get a user's Radarr watchlist feed
get.description: Returns the user's Movary watchlist in the format consumed by a Radarr import list. The feed URL grants access without a Movary login and must be treated as a credential.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The secret feed identifier generated in the user's Radarr settings.

get.description: Get information about the user authenticated by the supplied personal API token.

isAdmin.description: True if user is an admin, false if not.

review.example: A thoughtful review of the movie.

204.description: Successful operation, response has no content

400.description: The request payload or header are not correct

401.description: A personal API credential is missing or invalid

403.description: The authenticated user is not authorized to access the resource

413.description: The webhook JSON payload exceeds 262144 bytes

415.description: The webhook request uses an unsupported media type

message.example: The request could not be processed.

bearerToken.description: Personal API token supplied as an Authorization Bearer credential.

movaryToken.name: X-Movary-Token
movaryToken.description: Personal API token supplied in Movary's custom header. This remains supported for reverse proxies that use Authorization for Basic authentication.
